runs: 复算M3/M4基准守恒、阈值和网格误差
phases.stop_rule: 任一基准不能复现COMPUTE PASS口径则停止全部补充实验

phases.stop_early: single-phase limit mismatch>combined discretization error, balance residual>1e-5 after refinement, or unidentifiable fitted scales
validation loss diverges for all seeds, identifiability gate fails, or false-safe event prediction occurs
GNN does not beat POD-ridge on validation C-RMSE or violates false-safe rule; then retain only POD-ridge comparison
MLP fails to improve >=10% over ridge on validation C-RMSE; thereafter ridge alone

reporting_rows: model x split x seed x data_size
Q3/Q4 signed and absolute threshold error plus false-safe flag
train/solve/inference time, peak memory, parameter count and file size
fairness_exceptions: CFD has no supervised training; it is evaluated on identical test scenarios and receives only training-set observations for optional calibration
POD/GNN state inputs differ from pointwise PINN/MLP inputs; labels, splits, grid and metrics remain identical
hardware acceleration is reported separately; CPU comparison is mandatory
order_rationale: 先建立廉价无物理基线和PINN可识别性，再测试代理加速；CFD参数与代价最高，只有前述证据和资源允许时执行
